source.decision: Decision card 'Data 后端提速，做哪几项？': 四项都做 (A concurrent calls, B reuse on retry, C compact cells, D host-code fixes).

measured.workload: One workbook of 6 Excel tables x 1500 rows x 8 columns plus a 2000-line text file; fake model answering in 0.5 s (bench.py).
measured.note: Inventory time now is mostly openpyxl parsing (about 3.5 s) because the benchmark has no intake snapshot; real calls take a median of 69 s on the device, so labelling this workload falls from about 50 minutes (43 calls one by one) to about 4 rounds of calls.

changes: data_agents.py: run_calls (4 concurrent calls, DATA_AGENT_WORKERS) for DC-split sheets, DC-label pages, DP tables and split DC-review parts; results in plan order; first failure in plan order raised; stopped.json written under a lock.

data_agents.py: invoke(check=...) keeps a checked DC-split, DC-label or DP response under data_agents/kept/ and reuses it, checked again, for an identical request to the same executor; rejected splits are not kept.

data_agents.py: CELL_FORMAT and render_cell; content_cells gives parsed cells to host code and content_units the text models read; DC-split cells sent as {coordinate: text}; CSV items carry descriptor.source_format CSV and empty CSV fields are not listed.
data_agents.py: duplicate check indexes document number runs once; intake snapshots and their sheets parsed once per run; footnote lookup no longer quadratic in table size.
data_requirement_check.py 1.4.0: build_inputs takes a cell reader; cited cells outside the table range are SOURCE_NOTE, not body evidence (found while refactoring).
dc_coverage.json 2.5.0: DC002 states the cell format; runtime records concurrency and reuse.
not_changed: DR, DC-review and DH responses are not reused: their host checks continue across the step.
Inventory still reads one workbook's sheets in order; only DC-split calls run concurrently.
